description: listen --suppress on the VM kernel keyboard with an unbound Super+X: the hook's catch-all holds the key during capture (no bind runs, the probe never gets it, the compositor saw it); after whykey exits the same key reaches the probe, so whykey must report the normal route (pass) and not mistake its own hold for a consumer

/root/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua: hl.bind("SUPER + T", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("pgrep -f '[/]w/whykey listen' >/dev/null && echo during >> /tmp/fired || echo after >> /tmp/fired"), { description = "Lab fire" })
hl.on("input.keyboard.key", function(kc, ts, state) hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.exec_cmd("touch /tmp/reached")) end)
